title: Head of Digital Commerce (Ecom &Qcom)
description:
**Company Description**
UrbanGabru is a men’s lifestyle brand created to challenge stereotypes around men’s fashion and grooming in India. The company focuses on building a community of urban men who take pride in their personal style, grooming, and overall appearance. UrbanGabru offers products and content tailored to modern men interested in fashion-forward, well-groomed looks. The brand’s mission is to empower men to express themselves confidently and authentically through their lifestyle choices. UrbanGabru continues to grow as a destination for men seeking stylish, practical solutions for everyday grooming and fashion needs.

**Role Description**
The Head of Digital Commerce (Ecom & Qcom) is a full-time, on-site role based in Pimpri Chinchwad, responsible for leading UrbanGabru’s online sales channels and digital growth initiatives. This role oversees e-commerce and quick commerce operations, including platform management, merchandising, pricing, promotions, and customer experience across marketplaces and direct-to-consumer channels. The person in this position will analyze web and sales performance data, optimize conversion funnels, and coordinate with marketing, supply chain, and product teams to ensure seamless online execution. Daily responsibilities include driving digital strategy, managing key projects, leading cross-functional teams, and identifying new growth opportunities in digital channels. The role involves end-to-end ownership of digital revenue targets, process improvements, and continuous innovation in online customer engagement.

**Qualifications**

* Strong experience in Digital Strategy and Digital Transformation to build and scale e-commerce and quick commerce channels.
* Proven Project Management skills for planning, executing, and optimizing digital commerce initiatives.
* Demonstrated Team Leadership experience, including mentoring teams and collaborating across functions.
* Proficiency in Web Analytics and data-driven decision-making to improve traffic, conversion, and customer retention.
* Background in e-commerce, FMCG, or consumer brands, ideally in beauty, grooming, or fashion.
* Ability to work on-site in Pimpri Chinchwad and coordinate with internal and external stakeholders.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Marketing, Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Comfort with fast-paced, growth-oriented environments and a strong focus on measurable outcomes.

title: Creative Director
description:
The Creative Director will own the brand's creative vision and translate business objectives, consumer insights and cultural trends into distinctive brand ideas and campaigns. The role will be responsible for taking work from strategy and concept through execution, ensuring that every consumer-facing touchpoint is aligned with the brand's positioning, tone and creative identity. The candidate should not be only a design or content manager. The person must understand the complete creative ecosystem including brand strategy, campaign ideation, storytelling, social and digital content, influencer and creator collaborations, experiential activations, partnerships, production and creative team leadership.

**Key Responsibilities-**

**1. Overall Creative Ownership**

* Own the overall creative vision and direction for the brand across campaigns, content, social, digital, experiential and other consumer touchpoints.
* Develop creative territories, big ideas and campaign concepts aligned with brand positioning and business objectives.
* Lead creative work end-to-end, from brief interpretation and ideation through execution and rollout. Ensure consistency of the brand's voice, tone, storytelling and creative identity across platforms.
* Build a creative culture that encourages original thinking, experimentation and culturally relevant work.

**2. Creative Strategy & Campaign Development**

* Translate consumer insights, market trends and cultural conversations into relevant and differentiated creative ideas.
* Develop integrated 360° campaigns across digital, social, influencer, experiential, partnerships and offline media.
* Work with Brand and Marketing teams to turn business objectives into strong creative briefs and campaign platforms.
* Develop creative routes for product launches, seasonal campaigns, topical moments and brand initiatives. Use audience behaviour, cultural insights and campaign learnings to continuously improve creative strategy.

**3. Content, Culture & Social**

* Build a strong social-first and content-led creative approach for the brand.
* Stay closely connected to pop culture, entertainment, fashion, music, internet culture and emerging trends. Identify moments where the brand can participate meaningfully in cultural conversations.
* Develop topical content, editorial ideas, storytelling formats and recurring content properties.
* Create work designed to build organic conversation, engagement and brand relevance.

**4. Creative Partnerships & Experiential**

* Lead creative direction for brand partnerships, creator collaborations, artist integrations and experiential activations.
* Collaborate with creators, influencers, artists, agencies, production houses and other external creative partners.
* Develop distinctive brand integrations that maintain cultural relevance while meeting commercial objectives.
* Explore and build creative IPs, properties and experiences that strengthen brand affinity.

**5. Leadership & Team Management**

* Lead, mentor and develop the creative team across copy, content, design, social and campaign execution. Establish clear creative standards, review mechanisms and execution processes.
* Build a high-performance creative culture focused on accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement.
* Guide teams from brief to final execution while maintaining creative quality and strategic alignment. Manage external agencies and creative partners where required.

**6. Stakeholder & Cross-functional Leadership**

* Partner closely with Brand, Marketing, Growth, Performance, Partnerships, Product, E-commerce and Business teams.
* Present creative concepts and strategic thinking to senior leadership and key stakeholders.
* Ensure creative plans are aligned with commercial priorities, timelines and business objectives.
* Resolve cross-functional challenges that affect creative quality, speed of execution or campaign impact.

**7. Creative Performance & Business Impact**

* Evaluate creative performance through engagement, reach, audience response, brand impact and commercial outcomes.
* Use campaign learnings, consumer behaviour and performance data to improve creative effectiveness. Connect creative decisions with business outcomes including awareness, engagement, customer acquisition and revenue contribution where relevant.
* Identify creative opportunities that can improve brand differentiation, organic growth and audience connection.
* Build a culture where creative ambition is balanced with measurable business impact.

**Required Skills and Experience**

* 8–12+ years of experience across creative strategy, advertising, brand, content, digital or integrated marketing.
* Strong experience developing and executing integrated / 360° brand campaigns.
* Proven ability to take campaigns from strategic thought and big idea through creative execution and market rollout.
* Strong understanding of brand building, consumer behaviour, cultural trends and contemporary pop culture.
* Strong conceptual, storytelling, copywriting and presentation abilities.
* Experience working with creators, influencers, artists, agencies and brand partners.
* Ability to balance creative ambition with commercial and business objectives.
* Strong stakeholder management and team leadership skills.
* Experience managing and mentoring creative teams across multiple disciplines.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate should be a creative leader who understands how brand strategy, culture, content and execution work together to build a distinctive and commercially relevant brand. The person should be able to answer:

• What is the core creative idea the brand should own?

• How can the brand turn a consumer insight into a culturally relevant campaign?

• Which cultural moments are relevant for the brand to participate in?

• How can a campaign translate consistently across social, digital, experiential and offline touchpoints?

• Which creative ideas can generate organic conversation and brand affinity?

• How should creators, influencers and partners be integrated into the brand story?

• How can creative ambition be balanced with business objectives and measurable outcomes?

• How can the creative team consistently raise the quality and distinctiveness of the brand's work

Your work will directly contribute to Danfoss' ambition of becoming a preferred technology partner in India's rapidly evolving data center market.

title: Product Line Specialist
description:
Requisition Number: 77922
   

  

**The company built on breakthroughs.
   

  

 Join us.**
 Corning is one of the world’s leading innovators in glass, ceramic, and materials science. From the depths of the ocean to the farthest reaches of space, our technologies push the boundaries of what’s possible.
   

  

 How do we do this? With our people. They break through limitations and expectations – not once in a career, but every day. They help move our company, and the world, forward.
   

  

 At Corning, there are endless possibilities for making an impact. You can help connect the unconnected, drive the future of automobiles, transform at\-home entertainment, and ensure the delivery of lifesaving medicines. And so much more.
   

  

 Come break through with us.
   

  

 Corning’s Businesses Are Ever\-evolving To Best Serve Our Customers, Industries, And Consumers. Today, We Accelerate And Transform Life Sciences, Mobile Consumer Electronics, Optical Communications, Display, Automotive, And Solar Markets. We Are Changing The World With
   

  

* Trusted products that accelerate drug discovery, development, and delivery to save lives
* Damage\-resistant cover glass to enhance the devices that keep us connected
* Optical fiber, wireless technologies, and connectivity solutions to carry information and ideas at the speed of light
* Precision glass for advanced displays to deliver richer experiences
* Auto glass and ceramics to drive cleaner, safer, and smarter transportation
* Solar polysilicon, wafers, and innovative photovoltaic modules, enabling low\-cost solar energy solutions


 Purpose of Position
   

  

* Develops and executes a product line strategy that supports the achievement of desired product line sales growth and profitability


 Major Responsibility
   

  

 Works Closely With, Or Leads, a Cross\-functional Product Team Consisting Of Functional Leads From Development, Product Engineering, Applications Engineering, Manufacturing, Marketing And/or Sales To
   

  

* Develop the product or product line’s market value proposition and pricing strategy.
* Develop and execute the product line planning process, including the identification of critical projects to be undertaken for the year.
* Find the optimal solution (balancing the needs of Corning and the customer) to all product issues related to performance (i.e., specs, attributes, services), quality, share growth, customer needs (contract management)
* Create an intellectual property and standards strategy for the product line.
* Understand downstream market requirements and assess competitive threats and implications for the business.
* Create long\-term forecasting plans.
* Works with Program Management or New Business Development to ‘receive’ new products, as appropriate.
* Develops a compelling market value proposition that differentiates Corning’s products and services in the marketplace.
* Develops the product line strategy and manages the product line through the stages of innovation, from product concept through commercialization and life\-cycle management, as appropriate depending on the stage of handoff from Program Management or New Business Development
* May manage a portfolio of markets, in the case where the product line’s products hold different positions within the markets they reach.
* Identifies the best mix for the market(s) through effective segmentation and portfolio rationalization.
* Optimizes inventory management related to the product line by coordinating information flow, as needed, between Forecasting, Sales, Manufacturing, and other parties as needed.
* May get involved in supply chain disruption issues to influence or make decisions on global order and Development/Manufacturing prioritization.
* Works with Manufacturing and Sales to identify opportunities to reduce complexity and cost reduction in the manufacturing process both at Corning’s plant(s) and the customer site, as appropriate.
* Works with the Standards group to set and drive the standards strategy for the product line.
* Addresses new product/special requests by developing a business case (including P\&L and balance sheet implications) to determine the feasibility and pricing requirements of the requests.
* Owns and optimizes, or may work with the Pricing Manger to optimize, pricing levels by setting floor price, establishing pricing structure, optimizing product premiums, and ensuring value received for product line
* Works with Account Management to develop value propositions that improve margins for Corning’s products and services and enable new/enhanced selling opportunities with customers.
* Manages the obsolescence process, as necessary, to extract maximum value through the end of the product’s lifecycle.
* May oversee, develop, and direct a Product Line team.


 Education \& Experience
   

  

* Bachelor’s Degree \- Technical (engineering degree or other formal engineering education)
* MBA desired
* Intermediate Project Management Skills and Practices
* Product / Process Knowledge
* Customer Knowledge


**Required Competency (Skills, Knowledge And Abilities)**
* Demonstrated track record of managing projects.
* Demonstrated track record of leading and/or actively participating in multi\-functional teams.
* Fluent English written and spoken. Knowledge of additional Asian language knowledge is a plus.
* Good knowledge of Excel spreadsheets and MS Office in general
* Optical Industry Acumen is a plus.
* Technology around the Data Center including cabling and actives/networking are a plus.
